description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SanitizerException' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the core exception namespace. It provides a static method to create an exception indicating an badly formatted SVG.

classes.name: SanitizerException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, used for signaling errors related to sanitization issues, specifically for malformed SVGs.

methods.name: svgBadlyFormatted
methods.description: Factory method that creates and returns a new instance of SanitizerException with a message indicating a malformed SVG.
